instruction: Update all messages in the local Bills folder so they appear as unread.

rules.sql: select count(*) = 0 from messageAttributes where attributeID = 59 and value = 1 and messageID in (select id from messages where folderID = 13);

The SQL query verifies that no messages in folderID 13 have the read attribute set (count should be 0), meaning all are unread.
